blocked.name: Oresak v Kvasicich (the Kvasice Walnut)
blocked.reason: DEAD. Confirmed via cs.wikipedia.org and multiple Denik.cz articles: knocked down by a windstorm in August 2024. Was Czech Tree of the Year 2017, the most robust living black walnut in Czechia since 2011, protected since 1980-11-27, girth 611-672cm, height 25m, age ~230 years (planted c.1790), had survived a 1997 flood. Never ships as a collectible entry per the never-dead rule; may be worth a mention if a replanting/succession effort is later confirmed.

blocked.name: Vltavotynsky buk cerveny (the Tyn nad Vltavou Copper Beech)

location.address: Plot 880/1, production/industrial area, Pisecka street, Tyn nad Vltavou

blocked.reason: ACCESS BLOCKED under hard rule 10: two independent passes of cs.wikipedia.org both describe the tree as standing on plot 880/1 inside a vyrobni areal (production/industrial facility) on Pisecka street. No source found describing public access, a viewing point, or any right of way; nothing suggests this is company grounds with an open gate. Also a comparatively modest specimen next to the other Czech candidates in this batch: girth 279cm, age ~150 years as of 2003 (so roughly 170-175 today), height 19m -- protected since 1999-09-14, condition rated excellent in 2010, so the tree itself is fine, this is purely an access failure. Leave as a lead in case a future source confirms genuine public/viewable access (e.g. visible from Pisecka street over a fence) or the site changes use.
